name: Arfendazam
summary: Arfendazam (INN) is a drug which is a benzodiazepine derivative. Arfendazam is a 1,5-benzodiazepine, with the nitrogen atoms located at positions 1 and 5 of the diazepine ring, and so is most closely related to other 1,5-benzodiazepines such as clobazam.

pharmacology.text: Arfendazam has sedative and anxiolytic effects similar to those produced by other benzodiazepine derivatives, but is a partial agonist at GABAA receptors, so the sedative effects are relatively mild and it produces muscle relaxant effects only at very high doses. Arfendazam produces an active metabolite lofendazam, which is thought to be responsible for part of its effects.

summaryZh: 阿芬達占是一種苯二氮䓬衍生物藥物。阿芬達占是一種 1,5-苯二氮䓬類藥物，氮原子位於二氮䓬環的1位和5位，因此與其他1,5-苯二氮卓類藥物（如氯巴占）關係最密切。

uses.en: It was studied as a sedative and anti-anxiety drug but never marketed, and it is known only from research.
uses.zh: 它曾作為鎮靜與抗焦慮藥物被研究，但從未上市，只出現在研究中。
uses.zhHans: 它曾作为镇静与抗焦虑药物被研究，但从未上市，只出现在研究中。

sideEffects.en: It was never marketed, so its effects in people are not well documented. Benzodiazepines cause drowsiness, poor coordination and memory problems, and regular use leads to dependence, with withdrawal that can include seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 它從未上市，因此對人體的作用紀錄不多。苯二氮平類會造成嗜睡、協調變差與記憶問題，規律使用會導致依賴，戒斷時可能出現癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它从未上市，因此对人体的作用纪录不多。苯二氮平类会造成嗜睡、协调制差与记忆问题，规律使用会导致依赖，戒断时可能出现癫痫发作。

fact.en: Most benzodiazepines have their two nitrogen atoms at positions 1 and 4 of the ring. Arfendazam is a 1,5-benzodiazepine, like clobazam, which changes how it behaves.
fact.zh: 大多數苯二氮平類的兩個氮原子位於環的 1 與 4 位。阿芬達占和氯巴占一樣屬於 1,5-苯二氮平，這改變了它的作用方式。
fact.zhHans: 大多数苯二氮平类的两个氮原子位于环的 1 与 4 位。阿芬达占和氯巴占一样属于 1,5-苯二氮平，这改变了它的作用方式。
